claim: BuiltFrame is a read-only projection of the completed Scene and interaction state used synchronously during platform submission.
A forced render disables cached view reuse after GPU recovery before rebuilding and presenting the frame.

claim: Glyph origins are quantized to four horizontal variants and decomposed with fract and trunc.
Negative fractional origins cannot be represented correctly by the current fract-plus-trunc decomposition and can shift glyphs near negative coordinates.
notes: Supported by TR-ZZZ-004 and TR-SKIA-001; for -0.25 the correct pair is integer -1 and variant 3.

The atlas miss builder runs while the atlas mutex is held including platform glyph rasterization.
